title: Pass package.json team as owner in core-shell, billing, reports

summary: Shipped PLAT-103 via PR #1 (merged, CI+CD green). validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty/non-string; core-shell (platform), billing (payments), reports (insights) pass owner. Assumptions: owner values hardcoded to match each app's package.json 'team' (apps are inlined in the browser so package.json can't be imported); validateApp lives in-repo (libs/shared-contracts), so no registry library release was needed. All three apps built locally.
